title: Characteristic
description: Relevant Attribute of a Building or Building Unit.

value.description: Value that the characteristic assumes. The datatype Any is substitutable by an appropriate datatype. For example, for an EPC score, a QuantitativeValue with a value in percent or a skos:Concept with a qualitative value (A, B, C, etc.). For example, for immovable heritage, a skos:Concept with value EstablishedImmovableHeritage or ProtectedImmovable Heritage. Lijst van Any items.
